pages.title: Power of Hunger
pages.text: A trophy left after defeating the Herald of Hunger. Proof that you endured the trial of exhaustion.$(br2)The heart embodies the $(l:beginning/paths)$(#B03030)Path of Hunger$()$(/l).

pages.title: Heart of Hunger
pages.text: Right-click the Echo of the Beyond with the heart in hand to lower the $(l:beyond/pursuit)Pursuit$(/l) meter by 100.
